number_format: Inputs are binary64: 'binary64' is the shortest round-trip decimal, 'hex' the exact hex form, 'exact' the exact rational. Derived reals are decimal strings ('value', 40 significant digits) with the nearest binary64; 'exact' on a derived quantity is an exact rational. Deviations and cross-check residuals are short diagnostics, not references. SI units.
item: 6. Sensitivity of the item 5 SRSS responses to each mode's frequency (Rayleigh continuum)
reading: a conditional SRSS sensitivity: one mode's frequency varied alone, with its shape, its participation and its force-recovery coefficient q_n held fixed; SRSS over the first five modes. It excludes changes of the CQC coefficient, of the missing-mass rigid response, of the shape and recovery, and rotations

cross_checks.what: closed-form log-derivative of the SRSS response against a central difference with relative step 1e-20
